rationale: The replication successfully reproduced the static/energetic core: BP exchange energy converging to 4πJ (<0.5% error), Berg-Lüscher topological charge Q≈±1 with correct sign, lattice scale-invariance breaking demonstrating barrier-free collapse mechanism, and self-similar exponents α=1, β=1/2 matching the paper exactly. However, the central dynamical claims—the coupled Schrödinger+Landau-Lifshitz time integrator, collapse time t*, electron b-field vortex nucleation, and dissipation-dependent smoothing—were explicitly scoped out and not built. For a dynamics/mechanism paper, missing the actual time evolution limits coverage significantly, though the reproduced static quantities and scaling exponents show high agreement where tested.
